trigger.description: SRR6.46.3 auto-enrollment ran against the SRR6.46.2 autodiscovery candidate set and found zero ee-capable peers on the tailnet (no peers carry the `ee-mesh` tag, all candidates failed the capability handshake, or the discovery policy filtered them all out). The auto-enrollment outcome stays unmaterialized; this code surfaces so an operator knows the absence is observed, not a silent skip.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --json   # against a tailnet with no other ee-mesh-tagged peers

expected_emission.repair_contains: ee with mesh enabled on another Tailscale machine
